name: com.gameframex.unity.entry
description:
GameFrameX Entry — application entry point and facade layer package. Provides the static GameApp class aggregating accessors to framework subsystems (Asset, Scene, Network, Entity, Download, UI, Sound, Setting, Localization, Coroutine, Web, Procedure, GlobalConfig, Timer, Event, Fsm, Mono, Config, ObjectPool, Login, Payment and more) with conditional compilation so only used subsystems are compiled in. All accessors return components obtained via GameEntry.GetComponent<T>() with static caching, re-resolving automatically after Shutdown / Restart. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Entry — 应用入口与门面层功能包。提供静态 GameApp 类聚合框架子系统访问器（Asset、Scene、Network、Entity、Download、UI、Sound、Setting、Localization、Coroutine、Web、Procedure、GlobalConfig、Timer、Event、Fsm、Mono、Config、ObjectPool、Login、Payment 等），经条件编译确保只编译已使用的子系统。全部访问器统一经 GameEntry.GetComponent<T>() 获取组件对象并静态缓存，Shutdown / Restart 后自动重新解析。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
